title: AnalysisDocumentPayload
description: Payload of an analysis-document card. Renders as a long-form markdown document (research write-up, design memo, etc.). The body string can include GFM markdown, mermaid blocks, and inline references. The optional metadata block carries model / timestamp info shown in the document header.

title.description: Optional document title; defaults to a generic 'Analysis' label client-side.

body.description: Markdown body. May include mermaid code-fences.

modelId.description: Display model badge id (resolved to model option client-side).
